name: Dimensional Pull
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level arcanist 6, psychic 6, sorcerer 6, summoner 5, unchained summoner 6, witch 6, wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur and a pinch of aether)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature of your size or smaller
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You instantly teleport a creature from its current location to a chosen, empty space adjacent to yourself. If the target creature cannot fit safely into the new space without squeezing, or you try to teleport the target into an occupied space or a space it could not normally stand within, the spell fails.
